description: Deferred questions, removed from queries_automotive.json's gating set (was 13, now a stable 10-question core set). These 3 are documented, known-failing retrieval-ranking/LLM-formatting issues -- NOT removed because they're invalid, but because three independent fix attempts (lessons A124, A125, A126 in tasks/lessons.md) each either failed to fix them or fixed them at the cost of breaking the aerospace golden set (lesson A103's cross-tenant validation rule). Kept here for reference/regression-tracking; re-run manually if a future fix is attempted.

questions.question: Care este ținta (target) pentru indicatorul On-Time Delivery (OTD) stabilită de AutoCorp GmbH pentru furnizori?
questions.note: Known-failing (A123-A126): faithfulness=1.0, answer correct, but the csr-client-2023 chunk is structurally outranked by ~50 multi-hop chunks in the GNN-scored final list (seed rank index >=2 -> text_score 0.4-0.6, below the multi-hop ~0.85-0.97 band) -- 'insufficient citation recall'. Fixed only by A124's combined rerank_top_k=7 + _text_score [0.85,1.0] floor, which broke aerospace (4/39 pass_rate).

questions.question: Ce revizie a procedurii IL-INS-03 este referențiată în PC-COMP-07 pentru recepția materialelor, și corespunde aceasta versiunii curente în vigoare?
questions.note: Known-flaky (A113, A123, A126): faithfulness 0.75-1.0, retrieved context contains both rev2 and rev4, but the LLM doesn't consistently spell out both revision numbers in compact form in its answer. A126 strengthened the _ANSWER_PROMPT rev-number rule (kept, low-risk) but did not flip this particular run -- same class of LLM-sampling non-determinism as CON-03, which does pass intermittently.

questions.question: Dacă cerințele clientului din CSR-CLIENT-2023 privind frecvența reevaluării furnizorilor critici diferă de procedura internă RFA-REG-01, care document ar trebui să prevaleze pentru PlastiAuto SRL?
questions.note: Known-failing (A123-A126): faithfulness=1.0, answer correct, but the csr-client-2023 chunk ranks #7 of 55 in the GNN-scored final list -- 2 slots past the rerank_top_k=5 context cutoff (narrow margin, delta~=0.003-0.004). Fixed only by A124's rerank_top_k=7, which broke aerospace; rerank_top_k=6 alone (A125) did not recover it.
